title: Annie Oakley
description:
S01 E24 — Annie Makes a Marriage
Annie (Gail Davis) plays matchmaker for her friend Bess Murdock (Nancy Hale). With Don Kennedy, Brad Johnson.

title: Days of Jesse James
description: A singing cowboy (Roy Rogers) clears the outlaw (Donald Barry) and his gang of a bank robbery done by bankers.

title: Grand Canyon Trail
description: Not long after ambitious prospector J. Malcolm Vanderpool takes an interest in the run-down remnants of a small frontier town, fortune seekers from all over rush to gain a silver mine of their own.

title: Buffalo Stampede
description: Buffalo hide trader Tom Doan must track down and outsmart a gang of white thieves disguised as raiding American Indians to save the woman he loves.

title: McLintock!
description: A cattle baron (John Wayne) tries to tame his wife (Maureen O'Hara) amid a feud with settlers and trouble with Indians.

title: The Last of the Clintons
description: A cowboy sleuth (Harry Carey) catches rustlers despite a rattlesnake.

title: Vengeance Valley
description: A rancher's son (Robert Walker) gets his foster brother (Burt Lancaster) in trouble with an unwed mother's brothers.

title: The Legend of the Lone Ranger
description: When the Butch Cavendish gang ambushes a group of Texas Rangers, the only surviving ranger dons a mask to protect his identity and swears to bring them to justice.

title: Lost Canyon
description: After Johnny is accused of robbing a bank, he runs into the hills. When his friend Hopalong Cassidy hears what happened, Hopalong sets out to find the real bad guys.

title: The Diamond Trail
description: A New York reporter (Rex Bell) follows a gang of gem smugglers west.

title: Revenge of the Virgins
description: When white settlers start to move in on their sacred grounds, a tribe of female Indians vow to do anything they can to stop them.

title: Abilene Town
description: A saloon singer (Ann Dvorak) and her rival like a marshal (Randolph Scott) who cleans up a drunken sheriff's (Edgar Buchanan) cow town.

title: Call of the Forest
description: A young boy's camaraderie with wild animals comes in handy when he sets out to avenge his father's death.

title: Cowboy G-Men
description:
S01 E25 — Safe Crackers
Pat and Stoney are ordered to break up a safe cracking gang preying on Colorado banks handling government silver bullion.

title: Cowboy G-Men
description:
S01 E26 — Silver Fraud
US mint has been buying silver diluted with lead; Pat and Scotty set out to find the criminals.

title: Cowboy G-Men
description:
S01 E27 — Hangfire
Matt must restore order to a town controlled by outlaws.

title: Cowboy G-Men
description:
S01 E28 — Hush Money
Pat and Stoney investigate a land title dispute.

title: Petticoat Junction
description:
S01 E09 — The Little Train Robbery
A pair of crooks plans to rob the Cannonball of its bank shipment.

title: Petticoat Junction
description:
S01 E10 — Bedloe Strikes Again
Homer returns to Shady Rest in an attempt to scrap the Cannonball.

title: Petticoat Junction
description:
S01 E11 — Uncle Joe's Replacement
General store clerk Herbie Bates, is name assistant general manager of the Shady Rest by Kate, making Uncle Joe feel like he is being replaced.

title: Petticoat Junction
description:
S01 E12 — Honeymoon Hotel
Uncle Joe becomes a justice of the peace with hopes of attracting honeymooners.

title: Judge Roy Bean
description:
The Katcina Doll
Shorts and Hurley hold a doll hostage that brings good luck to a Mexican village.

title: Judge Roy Bean
description:
S01 E13 — Letty Leaves Home
A couple of con men attempt to lure Letty into their scheme and get her to go to San Francisco.

title: Judge Roy Bean
description:
S01 E39 — Lone Star Killer
A Texas Ranger is shot down in cold blood and Judge and Jeff are determined to break the case.

title: Judge Roy Bean
description:
S01 E37 — Luck o' the Irish
Judge Roy along with Taggart are intrigued by the arrival of Pat O'Hara and much younger wife Kate; Pat's fondness for drink and gambling has him involved with the town's rowdies.

title: Judge Roy Bean
description:
S01 E14 — Murder in Langtry
Deputy Jeff Taggart is framed in the murder of a horse trader.

title: Judge Roy Bean
description:
S01 E24 — Outlaw's Son
Judge Bean appoints himself as the legal guardian of a young man whose father was a member of an outlaw gang; the boy's uncle puts a bounty on his head.

title: Judge Roy Bean
description:
S01 E25 — The Reformer
Judge Bean's decisions displease some people, like prohibitionist Dolly Mason; she backs opposing candidate Duke Castle, an outlaw who claims he's reformed.

title: Judge Roy Bean
description:
S01 E06 — The Runaway
A young boy runs away from home because his father doesn't stand up to his abusive boss.

title: Jesse James Rides Again
description: On the run from the law over false charges, Jesse James and his friend find refuge in a small town threatened by a gang trying to claim the oil deposits beneath it. While there, he meets a pretty woman and father who are in danger.

title: Winds of the Wasteland
description: Two former Pony Express riders enter a dilapidated stagecoach in a race for a government mail contract.

title: The Star Packer
description: Marshal John Travers investigates the murder of a town's sheriff, makes it his mission to restore order to the town and bring down a bandit called the Shadow.

title: Land of Hunted Men
description: The Range Busters (Ray Corrigan, Dennis Moore, Max Terhune) track outlaws to their hide-out.

title: Raiders of Red Gap
description: The Lone Rider (Bob Livingston) and his sidekick (Al "Fuzzy" St. John) crunch an Arizona grazing-land monopoly.

title: Riders of the Deadline
description: Hopalong Cassidy (William Boyd) and his pals (Andy Clyde, Jimmy Rogers) get the drop on Mexican-border gunrunners.

title: The Deadly Companions
description: An ex-army officer accidentally kills a woman's son and tries to make up for it.

title: The Red Rope
description: Ranch hand Tom Shaw must face off against a nefarious gunslinger to save his lady love's ranch.

title: Ride, Ryder, Ride!
description: In their first cinematic outing, Red Ryder and his Indian sidekick help a newspaper publisher clean up her town.

title: The Gunman From Bodie
description: The Rough Riders (Buck Jones, Tim McCoy, Raymond Hatton) act like strangers to catch a crooked lawyer.

title: Springtime in the Sierras
description: A gang of poachers must be stopped as they kill and sell game out of season. Roy figures out who the culprits are and goes undercover to investigate further.

title: The Cisco Kid
description:
S01 E21 — Pancho Held Hostage
Cisco and Pancho capture a notorious bank robber after falling for a trap set by the criminal's sister.

title: The Cisco Kid
description:
S01 E22 — Freight Line Feud
Cisco and Pancho attempt to convince a freighting company owner that her competitor did not steal from her wagons.

title: The Cisco Kid
description:
S01 E23 — Phony Sheriff
A phony sheriff is part of a rustling scheme.

title: The Cisco Kid
description:
S01 E24 — Uncle Disinherits Niece
Cisco and Pancho discover the shady motives of a lawyer hired to change a rancher's will.

title: Stories of the Century
description:
S01 E25 — Ben Thompson
Matt and Frankie look into Ben Thompson's background; Matt gets a job at a gambling den to obtain evidence about Ben's criminal activities.

title: Stories of the Century
description:
S01 E26 — Clay Allison
Matt arrests John Allison; Frankie's doctor is kidnapped; Clay falls into Matt's trap.

title: Stories of the Century
description:
S01 E01 — Belle Starr
Matt Clark and Frankie Adams pursue a female outlaw named Belle Starr after her gang steals a herd of horses from the U.S. cavalry.

title: Stories of the Century
description:
S01 E02 — Billy the Kid
Matt teams with Pat Garrett after a large herd of horses is stolen.

title: Bonanza
description:
S01 E26 — The Avenger
A wanderer seeking his parents' lynchers, arrives in Virginia City as Ben and Adam are convicted of murder.

title: Bonanza
description:
S01 E29 — Bitter Water
When a neighbor agrees to sell his property, the Cartwrights fear the loss of water rights for their cattle.

title: Bonanza
description:
S01 E30 — Feet of Clay
The Cartwrights befriend a boy whose father has been sent to jail and whose mother has recently died.

title: Bonanza
description:
S01 E31 — Dark Star
Little Joe falls for a girl who has been disowned by her people because they think she is a witch and, therefore, an outcast.

title: Arizona Bound
description: The Rough Riders (Buck Jones, Tim McCoy, Raymond Hatton) team up to save a woman's stagecoach line from a Mesa City saloon gang.

title: The Man From Music Mountain
description: A singing rancher (Gene Autry) and his sidekick (Smiley Burnette) catch swindlers selling lots in a ghost town.

title: The Hanged Man
description: A former gunslinger survives his own hanging and transforms himself into a mysterious avenger of injustice.

title: Sagebrush Trail
description: A man is falsely imprisoned on a murder charge, then escapes to join an outlaw gang and unmask the real killer.

title: The Lucky Texan
description: Jerry Mason (John Wayne) and his friend Jake (George Hayes) have to keep two crooks away from their gold.

title: Fighting Caravans
description: A French girl (Lily Damita) joins a wagon train from Missouri led by two scouts and their young partner (Gary Cooper).

title: One-Eyed Jacks
description: An ex-convict bandit (Marlon Brando) finds the partner (Karl Malden) who betrayed him is now a town sheriff with a wife (Katy Jurado) and daughter.

title: Fighting Westerner
description: Heirs of a radium mine owner face murder attempts. A mining engineer investigates to find the killer and prove his cousin's innocence. The mine's value motivates the crimes.

title: Born to Battle
description: Cattlemen offer a jailed cowboy his freedom if he will agree to help locate a gang of notorious rustlers.

title: Brothers of the West
description: Detective Tom Wade (Tom Tyler) has to investigate the truth behind a robbery and murder of a bank president that's being blamed on Tom's brother, Ed (Bob Terry), who is nowhere to be found.

title: Young Bill Hickok
description: The frontier hero (Roy Rogers) sings and saves Civil War gold with his sidekick (George "Gabby" Hayes).

title: The Dude Ranger
description: An Easterner (George O'Brien) finds rustlers and a sweetheart (Irene Hervey) on the ranch he inherited out West.

title: 'Neath Canadian Skies
description: A Mountie tracks mine robbers in the 1890s Canada.

title: The Cisco Kid
description:
S01 E26 — Water Rights
A crooked stagecoach driver accuses Cisco and Pancho of stealing $50,000 from him.

title: The Cisco Kid
description:
S01 E01 — Boomerang
A prominent investment broker is captured after scheming to have two of his men impersonate Cisco and Pancho at a bank hold-up.

title: The Cisco Kid
description:
S01 E04 — Big Switch
A clever criminal hopes to rob a wealthy rancher, but Cisco and Pancho bring the man to justice.

title: The Cisco Kid
description:
S01 E05 — Convict Story
An escaped convict is nearly murdered while trying to prove that he did not commit a crime.

title: Stories of the Century
description:
S01 E03 — Frank and Jesse James
Matt and Frankie go to Kansas City to aid in the capture of outlaw brothers Frank and Jesse James.

title: Stories of the Century
description:
S01 E04 — Geronimo
When the Apache chief leads a raid on a train depot, looking for weapons and provisions, one of his braves is captured.

title: Stories of the Century
description:
S01 E05 — Quantrill and His Raiders
Despite their position undercover as members of the infamous Quantrill gang, Matt and Frankie cannot stop them from carrying out a vicious massacre in Lawrence, Kan.; Matt sets out to hunt down Quantrill for what happened.

title: Stories of the Century
description:
S01 E06 — Cattle Kate
Matt and Frankie investigate a woman's suspicious cattle ranch amid a crisis threatening competing ranches in Sweetwater, Wyo.

title: Hawkeye and the Last of the Mohicans
description:
S01 E01 — Hawkeye's Homecoming
Hawkeye finds out that his brother has joined the British army and is now a "redcoat."

title: Hawkeye and the Last of the Mohicans
description:
S01 E02 — The Threat
Hawkeye and Chingachgook find a group of new settlers, trapped in the Huron's territory.

title: Hawkeye and the Last of the Mohicans
description:
S01 E03 — Franklin Story
After several people are murdered Hawkeye seeks the help of his friend Benjamin Franklin.

title: Hawkeye and the Last of the Mohicans
description:
S01 E04 — The Wild One
A young Indian Doctor attempts to practice medicine while the townspeople practice intolerance.

title: Hawkeye and the Last of the Mohicans
description:
S01 E05 — Delaware Hoax
The Delaware tribe, friends of Chingachgook, are framed for a murder they didn't commit.

title: Hawkeye and the Last of the Mohicans
description:
S01 E06 — The Coward
Tom and his father are attacked by Hurons; Tom runs away in fear leaving his wounded father behind.

title: Hawkeye and the Last of the Mohicans
description:
S01 E07 — The Ethan Allen Story
Ethan Allen and the Green Mountain Boys are at war with the ruthless tax collectors, a bunch of outlaws, more Robin Hood than the Dalton gang; when the authorities start to pin their misdeeds on them, Hawkeye must sort it out.

title: Hawkeye and the Last of the Mohicans
description:
S01 E08 — The Witch
Someone is going to a lot of trouble to convince the townspeople that a witch has cursed them.

title: Code of the Fearless
description: A Texas Ranger pretends he has been discharged from service to trick outlaws into accepting him into their gang.

title: Song of Arizona
description: A youth from Gabby Whittaker's (George "Gabby" Hayes) Half-a-Chance Ranch for boys from troubled homes becomes a pawn in the fight between his late father's gang and Roy Rogers.

title: Kentucky Rifle
description: Stranded settlers (Chill Wills, Lance Fuller, Cathy Downs) enter hostile territory with a wagonload of rifles.

title: The Lawless Frontier
description: A cowboy (John Wayne) protects a girl (Sheila Terry) and her father (George Hayes) from a rustler and a sheriff.

title: Blue Steel
description: Marshal John Carruthers helps a sheriff find out who stole the town's payroll, and together they discover the town's leader stole the money to buy up all the land.

title: Between Men
description: A blacksmith's son (Johnny Mack Brown) goes to New Mexico to find his benefactor's (William Farnum) disinherited granddaughter (Beth Marion).

title: Rage at Dawn
description: A special agent (Randolph Scott) poses as a train robber to infiltrate Frank Reno's (Forrest Tucker) outlaw gang.

title: The Painted Desert
description: A tungsten miner (Bill Boyd) loves his father's rival's daughter (Helen Twelvetrees) and fights off her other suitor (Clark Gable).

title: The Courageous Avenger
description: A law officer tries to bring a traitorous mine foreman to justice.

title: Sitting Bull
description: President Grant helps a cavalry major (Dale Robertson) condemned for helping Dakota Chief Sitting Bull (J. Carrol Naish).
